clips.title: The story
paras: The Electrocutioner 6000 is a deadly, super-charged spider tank deployed to defend the Launch Bay within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan. It fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the leper gnomes who follow him, holding the upper platform against anyone pushing deeper into the fallen city.

Gnomeregan's fall left its war machines in the hands of Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who still follow him. The Electrocutioner 6000, a hulking spider tank crackling with high-voltage current, stands guard on the upper platform of Gnomeregan's Launch Bay and lashes intruders with electricity.

The machine also guards a prize: the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its workshops. Those who bring down the Electrocutioner can claim the key and a quicker route into the city's depths.
